convert_schematic_to_numpy: run the python script to convert a .schematic file to a .npy 4d-array format
run_schematic_convert_cli: run the schematic_convert CLI tool with a schematic input file and output file path
build_schematic_converter: build the schematic_convert binary using make if it does not already exist in the repo bin directory
review_schematic_convert: review the python schematic_convert script that decompresses gzip schematic files and converts them to numpy arrays
summarize_schematic_convert: summarize the schematic_convert tool that converts .schematic files to .npy formatted 4d-arrays of uint8
